Line Charcteristics

  • This line is the first branch line of .
  • This line was once the longest branch line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division at 10.395km. However, this record was later broken in S3E13P2 by , another Branch Line when it extended to Vayler Station and became 10.66km long, only to once again keep the record of the longest branch line in S3E14P1 at 16.17km long.
  • This line was the first Nazca Railway Line to adopt the Sub-Standard Railway Standards. However, with the expansion of platform lengths and Platform Gate Installation of its stations between and to 204m, this is no longer the case.
  • and were the first two stations involved in Phase 1 ( - ) of this line to have its platforms extended and Platform Gates installed to compliment development in S3E19, while this line was also extended to . Other stations in this section subseqently underwent standardization works as part of Pre-Season 4 Phase 2 Development in anticipation of future development in Odyssey.
  • While this line is the first Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division line to extend despite having completed construction, is the first line to have stations inserted in it despite having completed expansion.
  • Between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station, the average interstation distance is shorter, but the interstation distance became normal once again between North Mountain Station and Peacean Island Station.
  • This line holds the record of the shortest interstation distance between Southend Station and Savanna Central Station at 560m long only.
  • All stations along this line between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station, as well as Lotusville Station and Gunshot Island Station, contain NR Shops.
  • This line has priority over other lines in terms of completing Second Stage Upgrading Works as the last station (North Mountain Station) completed the works on October 19 2017. During the Updating Works, all platform numbers have been reversed. All Sava Line Platforms (To at the time of the upgrades) changed from Platforms 2, 4 to Platforms 1, 3, and all Sava Line Platforms (To at the time of the upgrades) chaged from Platforms 1, 3 to Platforms 2, 4, while North Mountain Station has exchnged platforms 4 and 5, with the Up Direction and Down Direction of the line reversing as well.Before October 2017, the Up Direction of this Line is for Savanna Central Station, while the Down Direction is for North Mountain Station. However, since then, the Up Direction has become North Mountain Station (Now further extended to Peacean Island Station), and the Down Direction has become Savanna Central Station (Now further extended to West Shoal Checkpoint).</ref> However, Nazca Railway did not clearly state the purpose of the platform number change, and rumors of merging with have not been confirmed either. Ultimately, the two lines are confirmed to transfer at Peacean Island Station without merging.
  • The first phase of the line (from North Mountain Station to Savanna Central Station) commenced its upgrade project over seven years after its completion. The platforms has been extended from 152 meters to 204 meters and platform screen doors have been installed.

  • The Stations and routes between Lotusville Station and North Mountain Station alludes to the Tuen Ma Line Stations, with the section between Vanilla Bay Station and North Mountain Station using Noise Barrier-styled, semi-confined structures.
  • The Train Arrival Announcements of this line allude to the now-defunct Ma On Shan Line Train Arrival Announcements.

Platforms

Length

In the first phase of the line (between Hillum Station and Southend Station), the platforms were only 152 meters long. However, starting from Vanilla Bay Station, the subsequent platforms were built a length of 204 meters. In 2024, NR officially initiated an upgrade project, extending the platforms of all stations between and to a length of 204 meters (the standard length of all platforms). It should also be noted that and already ahve platforms that are 204m long during the expansion. The length of Hillum Station Platform 1 is 223m after standardization.

Platform Screen Doors/Gates

In the first phase of the line (from North Mountain Station to Savanna Central Station), platform screen doors were not installed. They were subsequently added to stations starting from Horsepower Island Station. In 2024, NR officially initiated an upgrade project and installed platform screen doors from Savanna Central Station to North Mountain Station. It is worth noting that Vanilla Bay Station had platform screen doors installed one year after its completion, and The Three Pass Station and Southend Station already completed upgrading works during its expansion.

title: Seaside Boardwalk

'''Seaside Boardwalk''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the South of the East Coast of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-17.

History

Since the beginning of Asylum Development, the Developer ofAsylum has always wanted to build a large-scaled Private Housing Project at the South Side of the East Coast of Asylum with a size rivalling that of Heng Fa Chuen, and that project is named Seaside Boardwalk. Seaside Boardwalk is the last Private Housing Project in Asylum to complete, and is separated in three phases with a total of 82 Blocks that provides a total of 15'496 flats, making it the largest Private Housing Estate in Asylum.

title: Senriyama
safeHtml:
'''Senriyama''' is one of the sub-districts of Peckern and mainly consists of residential areas. Before re-construction of this area, Senriyama had a population of 190 thousand, and was the most densely populated area in Peckern Continent at 140 thousand residents per square kilometer.

Geography

Senriyama is located at the south of Heart Peninsula and Landing Pole. It is surrounded by sea on three sides, and is approximately 16km from Downtown. This place was named after the fact that, before development, peaks of mountains extended mile after mile. The area of this place is approximately 0.82 square kilometers, with two-thirds of the development area derived from landscaping works, and one-third of the development area from reclamation.

History

First Round of Development

Senriyama used to be a small village with a population of only 100, and villagers lived off fishing. However, in 2017, developement of this area commenced, and at the time, Senriyama's sub-districts is divided based on public housing:

  • South Senriyama Estate: South Senriyama Estate is the first public housing estate in Senriyama, and is located at the north of Senriyama despite its name. In total, South Senriyama Estate provides 12'158 housing flats in its 16 buildings, and serves a population of 34 thousand. To the west of South Senriyama Estate is a large shopping mall used for leisure of Senriyama residents. In the middle of South Senriyama Estate also lies a Bus Terminus and a Market.
  • Beak Wood Estate: Beak Wood Estate is located between South Senriyama Estate and Beak Beach Estate. In total, Beak Wood Estate provides 7'612 housing flats in its 20 buildings. However, due to inappropriate planning, complaints from residents were of common occurrence.
  • Beak Beach Estate: Beak Beach Estate is located in the south of Senriyama. It provides 3'696 housing flats in its 13 buildings, and serves a population of 10 thousand. All public facilities in Beack Beach Estate are also considered to be in the Beak Beach Sub-District. It features a car park and a tiny shopping mall.
  • Beak East Estate: Beak East Estate is located in the east of Senriyama, and is an extension of Senriyama. It is named after the fact that it is located to the east of Beak Beach Road. Most of the land in Beak East Estate is from reclamation, and development is now complete. Excluding the 114 detached houses in Phase V, it provides 14'404 housing flats in its 27 buildings for its 40 thousand residents. It is currently the largest sub-district in Senriyama, and many facilities, such as a basketball court, a leisure park, and a public toilet, are available for use of residents. Moreover, Decajoul Catering Corporation had to set up a supermarket in that area due to increasing demand of daily necessities.
  • North Senriyama Estate: North Senriyama Estate is located in the north of Senriyama, and most of its lands is from landscaping works. It provides 3'960 housing flats in its 11 buildings, and serves a population of 11 thousand. However, most North Senriyama Estate residents were dependent on facilities at South Senriyama Estate as development is not yet complete.
  • Charmful Garden: Charmful Garden is located in the north of Senriyama, and is at a good distance from the rest of the properties in Senriyama. It is also a rare instance of private housing in Senriyama. It provides 4'158 housing flats in its 21 buildings for its 12 thousand residents. While it has adequate facilities to be self-sufficient, transportation is not as convenient as other housing properties. In most instances, residents either have to take the for extenal access or walk 400m to the nearest bus terminus. While there were plans for Charmful Garden to be separated from Senriyama, the proposal was rejected.

Reconstruction

After much development, Senriyama population became saturated, and further construction of housing properties was no longer feasible. Moreover, inadequate planning meant Senriyama may have to be rebuilt from scratch. Currently, Senriyama has now been re-proposed to include commercial and leisure facilities, as well as the official construction of the Senriyama government building, and to spread out the population density of Senriyama, all in all to increase quality of life.

After reconstruction, some pieces of land that were neglected during the first round of development were able to be utilized and developed, including the current Lam Hong Garden and Beak Pludemet. Moreover, streets within the center area were redesigned into one-way streets and re-organized to alleviate traffic flow, and were named based on the housing estates built in the first round of development for better navigation. However, while reconstruction works were carried out, a few newly constructed buildings also retained properties of their predecessors.

In response to population demand, the South Senriyama Estate Bus Terminus is expanded and renamed "Senriyama (C) Bus Terminus", with new bus termini nearby to alleviate stresses. With the extension of to Senriyama Station, the bus termini and other railway routes passing through Senriyama were integrated as a compound development. Thus, Senriyama Shopping Center is born. This building marks the city center and the transport hub of Senriyama. Currently, underground structure and parts of the underground walkway are complete.

Housing Estates

  • South Senriyama Estate
  • Beak Wood Estate
  • Beak Beach Estate
  • Beak East Estate
  • North Senriyama Estate
  • Charmful Garden

External Access

Currently, Senriyama Station provides railway services for its residents, and many bus companies also set up bus routes in Senriyama to alleviate excess demand due to induced railway demand. In terms of trunk roads, Route 6A and Peckern Viaduct are also designed for road transport demands in Peckern. Moreover, Route 12 is also available for direct access to Downtown.

Education

While Senriyama was home to only one secondary school named Senriyama Girls Secondary School, there are further plans to build a primary school near South Senriyama Estate. After repeated petitions, a secondary school for boys was also built in Beak Beach Estate. However, due to the vast population within this district, most students still needed to study in other districts.
